STRATEGY: Parent slot 5: initial C, retaliate if opponent defected while we cooperated, mostly cooperate if opp_rate>=0.8, defect if <=0.3, TFT with defection streak detection, random at end. Simulated against population/archive IPD opponents with payoffs CC=3, CD=0, DC=5, DD=1, 100 rounds, no noise. Changed by designing an adaptive exploit/cooperate strategy that tests and exploits always-C opponents while retaliating against defectors.

STRATEGY: Parent is a tournament IPD strategy; trace simulates TFT, Always C, GTFT, Pavlov, slot0, random, always D; it revises its own exploit/test logic (single test defection, retaliation detection, cooperative vs exploit mode, endgame defection) rather than the given report.

--- PART 3/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Use these general suggestions while pursuing the stated tournament objective."
STRATEGY: The parent is a tournament strategy that starts cooperatively, tests with a defection, detects retaliation, then exploits non-retaliatory opponents. The trace simulates this strategy against TFT, always C, always D, random, slot0, and slot1, tracing round-by-round payoffs. It revises the strategy by reordering checks (defect if opp_d > 0.6*n), adding a delayed-retaliation detector, and switching to always-C in cooperative mode except near the endgame.

--- PART 4/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Given the benefit of aggressive exploitation, this is acceptable." / "So we should always cooperate in retaliated branch." / "So 20% is a safe baseline."
STRATEGY: The parent is a retaliatory/forgiving strategy that cooperates early, tests with a single defection, then exploits non-retaliators while cooperating to restore after retaliation. The trace simulates this parent against TFT and a threshold retaliator (slot1), and revises the cooperative/retaliatory branch to always cooperate after detecting retaliation, while considering a safe 20% defection rate against threshold retaliators.

--- PART 5/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Use these general suggestions while pursuing the stated tournament objective." / "So the strategy is:" / "I think this is a solid improvement over the parent."
STRATEGY: Parent is a general cooperation-advice strategy (start cooperative, forgive, repair, preserve mutual cooperation). Simulated against TFT, slot0, always-D, random, slot1, slot4. Changed to a statistical retaliation detector (dd/dc/cd/cc rates) plus aggressive exploitation (80% D) when non-retaliatory, cooperation when retaliatory, and endgame defection.
